From: Alex Ruiz <alex@finaxiom.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested — saw pricing page, want a quick demo

Hi Lauren,

I just filled out the pricing page form and wanted to follow up directly. We're evaluating Redwood for an inference layer — primary use is inference for document understanding pipelines. Budget is roughly $80k-120k/yr (we have some flexibility).

Would love a 30-minute walkthrough of the hosted API and a run-through of cost controls (batching, caching) and Private options. I'm in PDT (San Francisco). I can do: Tue 8/19 10–11am, Tue 8/19 3–5pm, or Wed 8/20 9–11am.

Is there anything you need from me before the call? I attached a short PDF of our current stack (stack_overview.pdf) in the form — happy to share more.

Thanks,
Alex Ruiz
FinAxiom
alex@finaxiom.com

--
FinAxiom | Head of Platform
